gallery.title: File:Sangkar Burung Jalak Bali.jpg
gallery.description: The birdcage in West Bali National Park remains surrounded by trees to not only give fresh oxygen but also attract other birds and animals. Besides eating fruits, Jalak Bali also eats caterpillars, insects, worms, crickets, and seeds. Natural vegetations can give them all those varieties.

gallery.title: File:Pulau Menjangan 2.jpg
gallery.description: Menjangan Island is an island located in the western end of Bali Province. This island is part of the West Bali National Park. This National Park is not only home to Bali starlings, but also home to underwater biodiversity. Like in this Menjangan Island for example. The marine park is still well preserved with its clear water

gallery.title: File:Nelayan dan Perahunya dalam Pelayaran.jpg
gallery.description: The jukung (traditional boat) used by the local fisherman in Gilimanuk Bay (Teluk Gilimanuk), Bali. This is the daily activity you can see in Gilimanuk Bay, with most fishermen still using traditional boats for fishing. All the waters around Gilimanuk are part of the West Bali National Park.

gallery.title: File:Perfect Camouflage of Bird.jpg
gallery.description: Yellow bittern or burung bambangan kuning in Indonesian (Ixobrychus sinensis) is a small bittern in the northern Indian Subcontinent, east of the Russian Far East, Japan, and Indonesia. This photo is taken in the West Bali National Park, where yellow bittern is camouflaged in their surrounding bushes.

gallery.title: File:The Tree and Sunrise.jpg
gallery.description:
Pesona keindahan bentang alam hutan mangrove di Taman Nasional Bali Barat yang merupakan perpaduan dua ekosistem unik yaitu darat dan laut. Ekosisten darat berupa hutan mangrove, hutan pantai, hutan musim, hutan hujan dataran rendah, evergreen, savana, dan ekosistem river rain forest. Sedangkan tipe ekosistem laut meliputi ekosistem coral reef, padang lamun, pantai berpasir, perairan laut dangkal dan perairan laut dalam. Taman Nasional Bali Barat merupakan salah satu kawasan pelestarian alam dengan ekosistem asli dan merupakan habitat terakhir bagi burung jalak bali. Taman nasional ini memiliki keanekaragaman hayati laut seperti terumbu karang dan biota laut, memiliki vegetasi mangrove, hutan rawa payau, savana, serta hutan musim.
Beberapa bagian hutan mangrove di Kawasan Taman nasional Bali Barat sempat mengalami kerusakan karena alam dan kelalaian manusia, namun saat ini mulai dilakukan berbagai langkah konservasi dan rehabilitasi seperti penanaman kembali bibit mangrove di sepanjang pantai di kawasan TNBB oleh Pemerintah, LSM, masyarakat dan organisasi pecinta alam. Kesadaran akan pentingnya ekosistem hutan mangrove semakin meningkat dan membuahkan hasil, hutan mangrove yang rusak kini semakin menghijau  dan menjadi kawasan ekowisata yang menarik dan memberikan manfaat ekonomi bagi masyarakat sekitar.
